entities.name: PMID:25074630
observations: Retrospective cohort study using 32 months of operating-room turnover data at a university-affiliated teaching hospital.
Compared same-surgeon consecutive elective cases with planned surgeon swaps; turnover was analyzed with monthly batching and covariate-adjusted analyses.

entities.name: Surgeon swap turnover effect
observations: Mean turnover was 43.6 minutes for same-surgeon cases versus 51.0 minutes after a planned surgeon swap, an increase of 7.4 minutes (95% CI 6.8–8.1; P<0.0001).
The increase varied by surgical service, procedure-category change, time of day, and turnover frequency.

At an institution averaging 2.5 cases per OR per day, cumulative added turnover was far less than one hour per OR day and did not permit adding another elective case if eliminated; authors characterized the operational impact as minimal.
